## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +6.44%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +9.84%). Healthcare constructive: TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +9.11%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +5.44%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology weak overall: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -5.66%), AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -13.67%). Industrials soft: GE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -16.65%), ETN BELOW TREND (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -13.09%).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: ETN BELOW TREND (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -13.09%), CMCSA BELOW TREND (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -6.72%), AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -13.67%), GE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -16.65%), FCX CORRECTION (1W: -9.45% | 1M: +4.35%).

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W momentum: PANW (1W: +11.31%), META (1W: +9.25%), ACN (1W: +8.03%); note major divergence—multiple large names show 1W vs 1M sign flips (PANW, ISRG, WMT, LLY), so treat moves as tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed-to-weak with narrow leadership: META ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +13.63%), AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +8.31%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.54%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -5.66%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -13.64% | 1M: -6.76%). Sector 1W return: -0.32% (internal rotation, narrow leaders).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Soft overall: V ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +3.15%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.42% | 1M: +0.70%), JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.29% | 1M: -2.85%). Financials showing weakness in breadth despite select leaders.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Relative safe haven: TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +9.11%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +5.44%), JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -0.71% | 1M: +3.14%), UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -5.64% | 1M: -5.85%). Sector 1W return: +0.39% (positive but mixed internals).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Energy and select Healthcare exposures (XOM ABOVE TREND, CVX ABOVE TREND, TMO ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to weak cap-exposed Tech names (ORCL BELOW TREND, LRCX BELOW TREND, AMAT BELOW TREND); style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech wins and weak breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: META ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +13.63%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +6.44%), ACN ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +9.33%).  
BEARISH: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -5.66%), AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -10.92% | 1M: -16.87%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -13.64% | 1M: -6.76%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth positive; XOM/CVX ABOVE TREND).  
BEARISH: Technology (sector 1W -0.32% with multiple large-cap names BELOW TREND).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch META continuation above recent weekly highs to confirm continued ABOVE TREND leadership; NVDA needs sustained weekly strength to reverse BELOW TREND status; ORCL/AMAT continued below-week weakness would signal deeper correction in cap-exposed semis.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
JNJ (+60): JNJ news on EGFR data; price in CORRECTION (1W: -0.71% | 1M: +3.14%) — bullish headlines but short-term price divergence, watch follow-through.  
ISRG (+60): ISRG study positive; ISRG RECOVERY (1W: +7.71% | 1M: -4.40%) — sentiment confirming price strength.  
XOM (+50): XOM LNG update; XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +6.44%) — sentiment confirmed by price.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
CHTR (-50): Broadband warning in headlines; CMCSA (peer) BELOW TREND (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -6.72%) — sector-level risk confirmed.  
TSLA (-50): NHTSA chatter; TSLA CORRECTION (1W: -3.15% | 1M: +4.18%) — bearish headlines while 1M still positive, monitor for trend break.  
ASML (-45): Critical machine limitations noted; ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -9.82% | 1M: -13.70%) — sentiment matches price weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; style mixed / no clear leadership.  
META ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +13.63%) and Energy names XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +6.44%) are showing relative strength.  
Key risk: narrow tech leadership + major 1W/1M divergences (PANW, ISRG, WMT, LLY) and mixed sentiment (JNJ positive headlines but price dipping) — monitor for confirmed breadth improvement before adding beta.
